## DOWNLOADING

Download Meridian Rift from the [repository](https://github.com/Aphelion-Moon/Meridian-Rift), then follow the [server build and setup instructions](RUNNING_A_SERVER.md).

Option 1:
Clone the repository with Git:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Aphelion-Moon/Meridian-Rift.git
```

Option 2: Download the source code as a zip by clicking the ZIP button in the
code tab of https://github.com/Aphelion-Moon/Meridian-Rift
(note: this will use a lot of bandwidth if you wish to update and is a lot of
hassle if you want to make any changes at all, so it's not recommended.)

Build either source download using the instructions linked above.
